steps: Verify Annys identity using her government-issued photo ID and Social Security Number.
Collect Annys personal information: full name, date of birth, address, and phone number.
Select account type: choose 'Standard Checking Account' based on her stated needs.
Set initial deposit amount: $50.00 as minimum required to open the account.
Review and sign the account agreement electronically.
Issue debit card and set up online banking credentials.
Confirm account activation and provide account number and branch details.
